name: chevrons-right
description: A chevrons right with an open V and round ends.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: Owner clarified Chevron has four cardinal directions only, with four Double Chevron identities (chevrons-up/down/left/right), each in None/Square/Circle and Outline/Filled:8 identities times3 forms=24 variants. Single uses V vertices(-5.5,2.75),(0,-2.75),(5.5,2.75). Double uses two V marks with vertices(-4,2),(0,-2),(4,2), shifted vertically by -2.875/+2.875. Rotate by cardinal direction and recenter at12,12, with no directional scaling. Reuse the exact same glyph standalone and inside upright Arrow frames. Regular1.75 round caps/joins; Filled closes each triangle and expands by.875. Double solid triangles touch exactly with zero gap at the shared center. Frame exteriors have2px margins, square radius4 or circle radius10. Filled frames subtract the identical standalone solid silhouette. Circle clearance at Bold is at least.2218px for Double and.4758px for Single. All await owner review; no diagonal Chevron icons.

review.note: New shared glyph and frame-ready Chevron family; awaits owner review.
